process_description: CANONICAL list all capabilities for a user. Returns enabled modules and overlays. CANONICAL grant a module to a user. Admin-only. Adds the module to the user's enabled list. CANONICAL revoke a module from a user. Admin-only. Removes the module from the user's enabled list. CANONICAL get overlay modules attached to a user. Returns list of overlay module names. CANONICAL attach an overlay module to a user. Admin-only. Adds the overlay to the user. CANONICAL detach an overlay module from a user. Admin-only. Removes the overlay from the user.
